requirements.condition: When congestion is reported to an endpoint.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint reduces its sending rate in response as described in QUIC-RECOVERY.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can report congestion to an endpoint and observe whether its subsequent sending rate is reduced.

requirements.quote:
To enable ECN, a sending QUIC endpoint first determines whether a
   path supports ECN marking and whether the peer reports the ECN values
   in received IP headers; see Section 13.4.2.
requirements.condition: Before a sending QUIC endpoint enables ECN on a path.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint determines whether the path supports ECN marking.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The endpoint does not enable ECN before making this determination.
requirements.why_checkable: Instrumentation can verify that path ECN support determination occurs before ECN is enabled.
